name: Change Data Capture — MySQL → YugabyteDB via Debezium
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sudo apt-get update -qq && sudo apt-get install -y -qq postgresql-client && bash .devcontainer/scripts/setup-cdc-mysql-ybdb.sh && echo "✅ CDC MySQL exercise ready"'
postStartCommand: bash -c 'bash .devcontainer/scripts/start-cdc-mysql-ybdb.sh && echo "" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → cdc-mysql-ybdb-demo   (guided CDC MySQL demo script)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → cdc-mysql-ybdb-ws     (Workshop shell for manual commands)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → mysql-cdc              (MySQL CLI)" && echo "▶  Terminal → Run Task → ysql                   (YugabyteDB CLI)"'

tasks.label: cdc-mysql-ybdb-demo
tasks.detail: "The Live Sync Pipeline" — guided MySQL CDC demo: register connectors, snapshot, live INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE (init-cdc-mysql-ybdb/prompt.sh)
tasks.command: cd init-cdc-mysql-ybdb && echo '🔄 cdc-mysql-ybdb-demo  —  CDC pipeline demo (MySQL → Kafka → YugabyteDB)' && echo '   Run when ready: bash prompt.sh' && exec bash

tasks.label: cdc-mysql-ybdb-ws
tasks.detail: Workshop shell for manual CDC commands — curl, mysql, ysqlsh (init-cdc-mysql-ybdb)
tasks.command: cd init-cdc-mysql-ybdb && echo '🔌 cdc-mysql-ybdb-ws  —  Workshop shell' && echo '   Run manual curl and docker exec commands here' && exec bash

tasks.label: mysql-cdc
tasks.detail: Open a MySQL command-line client on the chinook database (init-cdc-mysql-ybdb)
tasks.command: echo '⏳ Waiting for MySQL chinook database on :3306...'; until docker exec -e MYSQL_PWD=yugabyte mysql-cdc mysql -h127.0.0.1 -uroot -e 'SELECT 1' chinook >/dev/null 2>&1; do sleep 2; done; exec docker exec -it -e MYSQL_PWD=yugabyte mysql-cdc mysql -uroot chinook
